title: 第八章 柳嬷嬷拎着竹篮来了
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
天刚亮，沈清萝就把账本摊开了。

    谢无咎坐在院中石凳上，脸色很冷。

    沈清萝没管他。

    她先把契文堂回执压平，又把昨夜那盆铜钱推到铁柱面前。

    “看看还能不能用。”

    铁柱伸手碰了一枚，缩回手。

    “烫。”

    沈清萝低头写了一笔。

    谢无咎冷冷道：“你又记什么？”

    “契文查验费三两，铜钱烫坏七枚，鬼火灭了大半，柜台也裂了。”沈清萝抬头看他，“谢渊主，我没让你现在赔，已经很客气了。”

    铁柱补充：“还有踩地费。”

    沈清萝：“记。”

    谢无咎冷声道：“你敢记幽冥渊的账？”

    沈清萝抬头：“欠债还钱，阴阳通用。”

    “幽冥渊从不欠人钱。”

    “那正好，保持传统。”

    阿青趴在槐树枝上，笑得纸人直抖。

    糖糕蹲在屋檐下，尾巴一甩一甩：“本仙宣布，他要是住下，每日另收掉煞清扫费。”

    谢无咎看向它。

    糖糕立刻抬头望天：“天气不错。”

    槐荫坡的天灰得像锅底。

    沈清萝刚要接话，院外忽然传来车轮声。

    吱呀吱呀。

    一辆小车停在院门口。

    车帘一掀，一个妇人拎着竹篮下来，后头还跟着两个低阶役煞。一个抱米袋，一个扛柴火。

    役煞看见满院小鬼，小鬼也看见役煞。

    双方都僵住了。

    妇人却像没看见，径直进门。

    “沈姑娘？”

    沈清萝站起来：“您是？”

    “我姓柳，平日照顾少爷膳食起居的。”

    柳嬷嬷上下打量她一眼，眼里多了几分满意。

    “姑娘生得清爽，眼神也正。难怪呢，少爷大半夜的，把自己都嫁出来了。”

    院中一静。

    沈清萝慢慢转头看谢无咎。

    谢无咎脸色黑得能滴墨。

    “嬷嬷。”

    “怎么？”柳嬷嬷把竹篮往桌上一放，“双生契都签了，还不许人说？”

    沈清萝立刻道：“柳嬷嬷，这不是嫁娶，是事故。”

    柳嬷嬷点头：“少爷这脾气，确实不像喜事。”

    阿青噗嗤笑出声。

    糖糕也没忍住，爪子拍了一下屋檐。

    谢无咎冷声：“你来做什么？”

    “送饭，送衣裳，再送床铺盖。”柳嬷嬷指挥两个役煞把东西往院里搬，“您被这契绑在人间，一时半会儿也回不去。难不成还白让沈姑娘养着您？”

    沈清萝原本想客气。

    听见这几样东西都不用她掏钱，她把客气咽了回去。

    柳嬷嬷继续道：“再说了，您身子不好，不能总在外头吹煞风。“

    谢无咎皱眉：“我无碍。“

    “您每次说无碍，都是快有碍了。“

    谢无咎冷冷道：“可我没说要留。”

    柳嬷嬷头也不回：“那您走。”

    院里所有人都看向谢无咎。

    谢无咎起身，往院门走。

    一步。

    两步。

    刚到门槛，沈清萝腕骨一烫，手里的茶盏差点泼出去。

    谢无咎也停住。

    他又往前迈了半步。

    沈清萝手一抖，茶水直接洒上袖口。

    “嘶！”

    她抬眼：“走得出去算本事！”
content_en:
At dawn, Shen Qingluo spread out the ledger.

Xie Wujiu sat on the stone bench in the courtyard with a cold face.

Shen Qingluo ignored him.

She first flattened the receipt from Qi Wentang, and then pushed the basin of copper coins from last night in front of the iron pillar.

"See if it still works."

Tie Zhu reached out and touched one, then retracted his hand.

"Hot."

Shen Qingluo lowered her head and wrote.

Xie Wujiu said coldly: "What else do you remember?"

"The inspection fee for the deed was three taels, seven copper coins were burnt, most of the will-o'-the-wisps were extinguished, and the counter was cracked." Shen Qingluo looked up at him, "Master Xie Yuan, I'm being very polite by not asking you to pay now."

Tie Zhu added: "There is also land stamping fee."

Shen Qingluo: "Remember."

Xie Wujiu said coldly: "Do you dare to keep accounts of Netherworld Abyss?"

Shen Qingluo raised her head: "Repaying debts is a yin and yang."

"Youmingyuan never owes anyone money."

"That's fine, keep it traditional."

Ah Qing was lying on a locust tree branch, laughing so hard that the paper mannequin trembled.

Tanggao squatted under the eaves and swung his tail: "I announced that if he stays here, he will be charged a daily cleaning fee."

Xie Wujiu looked at it.

Tang Cake immediately looked up at the sky: "The weather is nice."

The sky in Huaiyinpo was as gray as the bottom of a pot.

Just as Shen Qingluo was about to answer the call, the sound of wheels suddenly came from outside the hospital.

Squeak, squeak, squeak.

A car parked at the entrance of the courtyard.

As soon as the curtain of the car was lifted, a woman came down carrying a bamboo basket, followed by two low-level servants.One holds a rice bag and the other carries firewood.

Yisha saw the little ghosts in the courtyard, and the little ghosts also saw Yisha.

Both sides froze.

But the woman didn't seem to notice and walked straight in.

"Miss Shen?"

Shen Qingluo stood up: "Who are you?"

"My surname is Liu. I usually take care of the young master's meals and daily life."

Aunt Liu looked her up and down, with a bit more satisfaction in her eyes.

"The girl has a refreshing appearance and a good look. No wonder, the young master married himself off in the middle of the night."

There was silence in the courtyard.

Shen Qingluo slowly turned her head to look at Xie Wujiu.

Xie Wujiu's face was so dark that he could drip ink.

"Mommy."

"What?" Aunt Liu put the bamboo basket on the table, "The twin contract has been signed, but no one is allowed to talk about it?"

Shen Qingluo immediately said: "Mother Liu, this is not a marriage, it is an accident."

Aunt Liu nodded: "The young master's temper does not seem like a happy event."

Ah Qing burst into laughter.

Tang Cake couldn't hold back and patted the eaves with her paws.

Xie Wujiu said coldly: "What are you doing here?"

"Send food, clothes, and beds." Grandma Liu directed the two servants to move things into the courtyard. "You are bound to the human world by this contract, and you won't be able to go back for a while. Is it possible that Miss Shen is raising you in vain?"

Shen Qingluo originally wanted to be polite.

When she heard that she didn't have to pay for these things, she swallowed her courtesy.

Aunt Liu continued: "Besides, you are not in good health, so you can't always be outside blowing wind."

Xie Wujiu frowned: "I'm fine."

"Every time you say it's okay, it's almost as if it's okay."

Xie Wujiu said coldly: "But I didn't say I wanted to stay."

Aunt Liu didn't look back: "Then you go."

Everyone in the courtyard looked at Xie Wujiu.

Xie Wujiu stood up and walked towards the courtyard gate.

step.

Two steps.

As soon as she reached the threshold, Shen Qingluo's wrist bones felt hot and she almost spilled the tea cup in her hand.

Xie Wujiu also stopped.

He took another half step forward.

Shen Qingluo shook her hand and the tea spilled onto her sleeves.

"Hiss!"

She raised her eyes: "You have to go out and do your best!"
